1801252.detail: Shopee parent SKUs renamed numeric -> alpha and listings consolidated; variation SKU's third segment is now the pack quantity. Both schemes stay mapped so historical months re-upload identically. Fixes two silent bundle under-deductions (0010/B-0010, 007). Product name is now cross-checked against the SKU map on every row and disagreements are surfaced before confirmation. Adds SM-AUV-025 (Acneshield) and BD-06.
1801252.verification: Replayed all 7 historical order exports: 400/418 lines resolve identically, and the 18 that changed are the two bundle fixes. All 22 renamed listings resolve correctly; 13 pack-size and cross-check edge cases pass; 0 false-positive warnings across 418 historical lines and 34 renamed listings.
1801252.rollback: git revert 1801252. No stored data is written by this change itself, but any re-upload performed after it will have deducted the previously-missing bundle components — remove those Inventory_Out rows by Reference_ID if reverting.

_comment: Curated metadata per commit, keyed by short SHA. Everything else in the Change Log is generated from git. See docs/CHANGE_MANAGEMENT.md. Add an entry here whenever a meaningful change ships; commits with no entry still appear, with blank Detail/Risk/Verification/Rollback.

_versions._comment: commit SHA -> release version it shipped in. Earliest commit of a version anchors it; later commits inherit the most recent version at or before them.

_releases._comment: Per-version Known Issues / Notes / Owner. A caveat is exactly what a commit message doesn't say, so it cannot be generated — write it here.
